violations.description: General employee cleanliness. — --Food employee did not wash hands as necessary. -Employee came from outside and put gloves on to tend griddle without a handwash.
General employee practices. — --Employees personal drink and cell phone sitting on food prep cutting board.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Equipment that dispenses liquid/food/ice in unpackaged form was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. -Clean up inside top of big ice machine.--Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned adequately. -Clean floor fans.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. -Floors need cleaned.
General premises. — --Perimeter walls and roof did not effectively protect establishment from the weather and entry of insects, rodents, and other animals. -Back door has gap on side.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Equipment that dispenses liquid/food/ice in unpackaged form was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. -Big ice machine and coke ice bin need descaled. -Clean nozzle on ice cream dispenser.--Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned adequately. -Clean above fry warmer and shelving above main hand wash sink.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. -Floor edges need more thorough cleaning.
